lang.setbonus.elsewhere.command.detail1: Your whip tags last 3 s longer, and your Herdcaller's Standard reaches 8 blocks further.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.command.detail2: Needs the Marshal's Helm, Tabard and Tassets with the Warmarshal's Spurs.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.outrider.detail1: Melee hits made while sprinting, and arrows loosed while sprinting, deal +10% damage. Never against players.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.outrider.detail2: Needs the Outrider Chaps and Boots. Scales with your Vanguard and Marksman strength.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.steady_aim.detail1: Sneak, or hold still for 1 s while drawing: a full-draw bow shot flies with no spread and deals +30%.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.steady_aim.detail2: Needs all four Ridgewatch pieces. Bows only, never against players.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.starsight.detail1: Arrow hits refund 1 Glimmer (once per arrow) and mark the target for 4 s: your spells deal +10% to it.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.starsight.detail2: Needs the Starsight Visor and Prism Mantle. Scales with your Marksman and Caster strength.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.zenith.detail1: Under open daylight sky: spells cost 25% less Glimmer and Glimmer refills 25% faster.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.zenith.detail2: At night: -10% spell power, under a roof too.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.wolf_fury.detail1: Melee hits give a Fury stack (max 5, gone 4 s after your last hit): +4% attack speed each.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.wolf_fury.detail2: At 5 stacks, melee hits heal 10% of the damage dealt (5% against bosses). The Mead-Horn grants 3 stacks.
lang.setbonus.elsewhere.wolf_fury.detail3: Needs the Ulfhednar Mask, Pelt and Breeches with the Wolfskin Boots. Never against players.
